name: RepoForge
description: Browse GitHub repositories and delete selected files via the official API. Tokens stay in memory by default; optional password vault (PBKDF2+AES-GCM). No tracking. Talks only to api.github.com.
author: MR TAREK

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src https://api.github.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
